# Storage Requirements Quality Checklist: Local Object Storage

**Purpose**: Validate requirement completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability for local object storage infrastructure and asynchronous client access before task implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Infrastructure & Container Provisioning Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the exact container image tags and immutable version pins specified for MinIO and MinIO Client? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §Docker-Compose]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are socket healthcheck evaluation criteria and startup periods explicitly defined for the MinIO server container? [Completeness, Contract §Docker-Compose]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the auto-provisioning dependency relationship and polling retry loop for the default bucket (`knowledge-source`) fully specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Docker-Compose]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the named volume configuration (`minio_data`), mount target (`/data`), and persistence expectations defined across container recreations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are host port mapping defaults and parameterization requirements defined for both the S3 API (9000) and the Web Console (9001)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Contract §Docker-Compose]

## 2. Web Management Console & Ingress Boundary Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 - Are browser access requirements, console URL generation, and default authentication credentials specified for the built-in Web Console? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract §Docker-Compose]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the exclusion of custom application upload endpoints and custom upload UI components explicitly bounded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are single-file and multi-file batch upload capabilities via the built-in UI documented with clear user acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are maximum file size constraints and upload duration expectations quantified for browser-based document ingestion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Data Model §2.2]

## 3. Asynchronous Client Protocol & Data Model Requirements

- [ ] CHK010 - Is the asynchronous non-blocking (async/await) mandate explicitly required for all downstream programmatic client interactions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Contract §Storage-Client]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are DocumentMetadata entity fields (key, size_bytes, content_type, etag, last_modified) completely defined with strict type annotations and validation rules? [Completeness, Data Model §2.2, Contract §Storage-Client]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are the asynchronous lifecycle context management methods (`__aenter__` and `__aexit__`) specified for client session and connection cleanup? [Completeness, Contract §Storage-Client]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are chunking and streaming parameters defined for the asynchronous document byte retrieval interface? [Clarity, Contract §Storage-Client]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are Pydantic configuration schemas and `.env` alias mappings specified for runtime settings resolution? [Consistency, Data Model §2.3, Plan §Summary]

## 4. Failure, Edge Cases & Recovery Requirements

- [ ] CHK015 - Are requirements defined for bucket auto-provisioning idempotency when the service restarts with an already-existing bucket? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Docker-Compose]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the system behavior specified when disk storage limits are approached or reached during upload? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are client connection retry and error handling requirements defined for service restarts during active file transfers? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are requirements specified for handling non-ASCII, spaces, or nested path prefixes in document filenames? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §2.2]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the fallback or failure response defined when downstream services request non-existent object keys or buckets? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3]

## 5. Acceptance Criteria & Testability Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 - Are the startup time (<15s) and console accessibility benchmarks defined with verifiable, technology-agnostic outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is byte-for-byte data integrity across upload and retrieval cycles defined with an objective verification standard (checksum match)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 - Does the specification mandate unmocked, live-container integration testing in compliance with project constitutional principles? [Traceability, Plan §Constitution Check, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are data persistence verification steps defined to confirm zero data loss across container teardown and recreation cycles? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Quickstart §Scenario 3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
